item.title: Free Sight Words Set 1 Worksheets: 3 Printable Pages
item.description: Free printable Sight Words Set 1 worksheets to try with your child. Download 3 sample pages and print them at home or in class, in full color or in ink-saving black and white, US Letter or A4. No sign-up needed. The full pack has 22 pages.

item.title: Sight Word Practice Worksheets for Kindergarten: One Word Per Page (Set 1)
item.description: Printable sight word practice worksheets for kindergarten and first grade. One high frequency word per page with the same six jobs each time: read it, trace it, write it, find it, read it in a sentence and build it with cut-out letters. No prep, in color and in black and white.
